# OpenClaw Knowledge Ingest Plan

## Goal
Pull important current OpenClaw knowledge into the Ultimate Wiki so the system is not split between live runtime and forgotten config lore.

## Ingest targets
- gateway and service configuration facts
- channel and surface setup
- agent roster and purpose
- workspace conventions and startup behavior
- heartbeat / cron / messaging patterns
- known issues, pairing paths, and recovery notes
- host/node/device connectivity knowledge

## Method
- read current reality
- summarize into durable pages
- link to source-of-truth files/commands
- mark freshness and provenance
- separate canon vs chronicle vs troubleshooting
